title: Binance Adds COS/TRY, KAVA/ETH, MC/BNB & ONE/TRY Trading Pairs
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will open trading for COS/TRY, KAVA/ETH, MC/BNB and ONE/TRY trading pairs at 2022-01-28 09:00 AM (UTC). Please note: TRY is a fiat currency and does not represent any other digital currencies. Risk warning : Cryptocurrency trading is subject to high market risk. Please make your trades cautiously. You are advised that Binance is not responsible for your trading losses. Thanks for your support!
